skill.summary: Product listing optimization — titles, descriptions, images, video, attributes for TikTok search

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of TikTok Shop Listing Optimization skill.

- Analyze TikTok Shop product listings and identify optimization opportunities.
- Provide actionable, data-driven recommendations for titles, descriptions, images, video, and attributes.
- Generate step-by-step implementation plans tailored to your business.
- Deliver pros/cons comparisons of strategies, tools, and approaches.
- Output includes prioritized action items, tool suggestions, implementation timeline, and KPIs to track.
